summary: The Unlikely Best Friends Let us do these activities before we read. I Friends are an important part of our lives. What do you do when you are with your friends and how do you feel? Now, complete the following sentences by writing in the shapes given below. Share your completed sentences with your classmates and teacher. II The title of the chapter is ‘The Unlikely Best Friends’. Discuss in groups, and then discuss with your teacher. With my friend I _____________ play With my friend I feel _____________ happy Friendship Unit 2 40 Poorvi—Grade 6 Let us read I Gajaraj, the elephant, lived in the best booth of the royal stables. The king was fond of Gajaraj, and he had ordered that the elephant should be well looked after.
